lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible on the lateral flank, with higher density observed in the upper-mid section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the spot columns to create a grid-like pattern, most visible in the central-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges exhibit a sharp vertical gradient, with light reflecting on the upper edges and shadows cast immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: A large cluster of small teleost fish is visible around the anterior region, and several remoras are attached near the base of the left pectoral fin.
